items.statement: Published evidence will not support listing either app without version-specific real-user data, because vignette accuracy overstates real-world accuracy and real-user data show under-triage of some emergencies.
items.rationale: Directly answers the committee; the retrieved evidence already points this way.
items.risks: The review may miss unpublished company data.

items.statement: Accuracy will be lower for older adults, children and people with limited English than for other users.
items.rationale: Three records point in this direction.
